scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome to Comodo, the
city of dreams and fantasy,
where the nightlife never ends!
I know this area really well,
so let me know if you need
directions anywhere here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
歡迎來到克魔島，這座充滿夢想與幻想、夜生活永不落幕的城市！
我對這裡很熟悉，需要指路的話，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text: Casino
scripts.translation: 賭場

scripts.text: Hula Dance Stage ^3355FF(Dancer Job Change)^000000
scripts.translation: 草裙舞舞臺^3355FF（舞娘轉職）^000000

scripts.text: Weapon and Armor Shop
scripts.translation: 武器防具店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Tourist Shop
scripts.translation: 紀念品店

scripts.text: Kafra Co. Western Branch
scripts.translation: 卡普拉公司西部分部

scripts.text: Chief's House
scripts.translation: 首領的家

scripts.text: Pub
scripts.translation: 酒館

scripts.text: Campground
scripts.translation: 露營地

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^FF6633+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Casino, a haven for rest for
weary travlers and the heart
of Comodo's nightlife.
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^FF6633+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到賭場。
那裡既是疲憊旅人的休憩之所，也是克魔島夜生活的中心。

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^0000FF+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Hula Dance Stage, the place
where female Archers can
change jobs to Dancers.
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^0000FF+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到草裙舞舞臺。
女性弓箭手可以在那裡轉職成為舞娘。

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^00FFFF+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Weapon and Armor shop. Be
sure to check that shop for
any special items that are
unique to Comodo!
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^00FFFF+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到武器防具店。
別忘了進去看看，有沒有克魔島獨有的特殊物品！

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^515151+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Tool Shop. If you've never been
there before, then I suggest
you check it out and stock up
on tools you might need later.
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^515151+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到道具店。
沒去過的話，建議您看看，備些以後可能用得上的道具。

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^3355FF+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Tourist Shop where you can 
buy gifts that can only be found in the Comodo region~
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^3355FF+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到紀念品店。
那裡可以買到克魔島獨有的禮物~

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^FF5555+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Western branch of the Kafra
Corporation. They offer some
pretty important services that you may want to check out later.
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^FF5555+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到卡普拉公司西部分部。
他們提供一些很重要的服務，您之後不妨瞭解一下。

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^FF5555+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Chief's House. You're welcome
to visit him, and he's usually
happy to have visitors.
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^FF5555+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到首領的家。
歡迎您去拜訪，他通常很樂意接待訪客。

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^FF5555+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Pub. There, you can meet other
tourists, relax, and socialize
in an enjoyable environment~
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^FF5555+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到酒館。
您可以在那裡結識其他遊客，在愉快的氣氛中放鬆、聊天~

scripts.text:
Please refer to the cross mark,
^FF5555+^000000, on your Mini-Map to find the
Campground. Gather with your
family and friends, and enjoy
the special barbeque of
Comodo's camping grounds~
scripts.translation:
沿著小地圖上^FF5555+^000000十字標記的方向走，就能找到露營地。
和家人朋友聚在一起，享受克魔島露營地的特色燒烤吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, it always looks
like nighttime in Comodo
because it's built in a huge
cave. We don't get any sunlight
here, but the darkness here is
more exciting than gloomy~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，克魔島建在一個巨大的洞穴裡，所以總像是夜晚。
這裡照不到陽光，可這份黑暗並不陰鬱，反而更讓人興奮~
